steps.title: Perform Association Analysis
steps.instruction: Conduct a chi-squared test using SPSS 19.0 to analyze the association between clinical characteristics and CK/LDH levels across all lung cancer patients, as well as specifically for ADC and SCC subgroups.

steps.title: Perform Multivariate Cox Regression
steps.instruction: Execute multivariate Cox regression analysis to evaluate the hazards ratio (HR) for the negative and positive groups of LDH and CK and to identify poor prognostic factors.

steps.title: Analyze Correlation with Clinical Features
steps.instruction: Analyze the correlation between CK, LDH, and clinical features, specifically focusing on metastasis to determine if CK and LDH can serve as predictors for specific organ metastasis.

steps.title: Evaluate Independent Prognostic Factors
steps.instruction: Analyze whether CK/LDH can be utilized as an independent prognostic factor for poor prognosis in lung cancer, ADC, and SCC.

steps.title: Determine Survival Period Correlation
steps.instruction: Determine the correlation between CK/LDH positive levels and survival periods.
